identity_notes: Separate official Sakana AI Scientist-v2 (template-free, agentic tree search) system. Do not merge with original 2024/v1 or Agentic Scientist/v3.
selection_notes: Collected every distinct generated full manuscript located in official v2 repository/history, official ICLR2025 workshop repository/history, official blog, arXiv full source archive and 2026 Nature supplement. All 3 released manuscripts retained, including 2 rejected papers. The accepted-threshold paper was withdrawn before proceedings publication. Humans originally selected these 3 from multiple runs, so this is the complete located public official-release corpus, not a random or complete all-run sample. Third-party deployments remain separate search leads, not silently mixed into this official Sakana release.
system_release_date_basis: Official first-publication blog April 7 update says v2 was open-sourced.
deduplication_method: SHA256 deduplication, then complete generated-content equivalence with exact page-text/diff evidence. Three arXiv variants differ only in publication header, author, line numbering and AI watermark. Four older workshop artifacts differ only in compilation/font encoding or human review commentary. Nature embedded pages exactly equal arXiv variant complete page text except one supplemental document line counter appended per page. No title-only deduplication.
scope_limitations: Official report says multiple complete manuscripts per initial idea were generated across seeds, but only selected 3 full manuscripts are publicly located; number and availability of unselected runs unknown.
No public all-run Drive/ZIP corpus linked by inspected official sources was found. Repository history/release/tag audit is preserved in search_audit.
Original PDFs contain flattened human review annotations. Their scientific content requires audited annotation removal before judging.
Pest detection used human-prepared dataset inputs, recorded per paper; source claims selected scientific code/results/figures/text were unedited.
